fields.name: Name
fields.slugHint: Used in links. Leave it empty to generate it from the name.

validation.nameTooLong: Keep the name to 120 characters or fewer.
validation.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes, for example "summer-shirts".
validation.slugTooLong: Keep the slug to 140 characters or fewer.
validation.descriptionTooLong: Keep the description to 2,000 characters or fewer.
validation.logoType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
validation.logoTooLarge: Choose an image of 1 MB or less.

categories.description: Group Products in two levels: top-level Categories and the Categories under them.
categories.formDescription: A Category can sit under a top-level Category, never under another child.
categories.deleteDescription: The Category is removed for good. Categories with children or Products can't be deleted.
categories.parentHint: Leave it as none to make this a top-level Category.
categories.parentLocked: {{name}} has child Categories, so it stays top-level.
categories.emptyDescription: Create the first Category to start organising the catalog.
categories.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Categories appear here once an Operations User adds them.

brands.description: Who makes your Products. Products can be filtered and reported by Brand.
brands.formDescription: A name, a slug for links and, if you like, a logo.
brands.logoNotSaved: The Brand was saved, but its logo wasn't: {{reason}}
brands.deleteDescription: The Brand and its logo are removed for good. Brands used by Products can't be deleted.
brands.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB. A square image looks best.
brands.emptyDescription: Add the Brands your Products come from.
brands.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Brands appear here once an Operations User adds them.
